notes.title: Shattered is 1 year old! News on the consoles release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950399/f284311bafb84b9e3d8d2ecd4089f9067e84c498.png

Since today is Shattered's anniversary, here's a little overview of what we did since last February!

• Well, first we kept bettering the game for around 6 months. We made several content & bugfix updates, until we reached the best doable version of the game we wanted to achieve by the end of June.

• Then, we took a little break (yay summer!), before getting back to work. We took the time needed to find a trusted partner for, finally, a consoles port! Read more on that just below ♥

• And we may have started to actually work on a new project... We obviously can't tell anything for now, but be sure you'll be hearing about us soon enough 🤫

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950399/5c3292c7cda7cd001be7390dd2714efaa563fae0.png

"Publisher Forthright Entertainment and Redlock Studios will explore, slash, and hack their way onto Switch, Playstation, Xbox, and Epic Game Store in Q1 2022 with Shattered - Tale of the Forgotten King.  The Epic MegaGrant recipient game has an intriguing story that unfolds a universe with deep lore combined with one of the most unique and breathtaking aesthetics from any game that was released last year."

...This is what you can read on our dear partner's website, Forthright Entertainment.

We're super glad to announce that thanks to this partnership, Shattered will finally come out on Playstation, Xbox and even Switch!!
Tune in March 22nd for the date announcement ♥


Thanks for your everlasting support, Wanderers ♥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950399/a30787e2c8d683b79b7b7d5d95d2c3d3d1d3db80.png

notes.title: WE'RE BACK! With a patch notes & a discount: 35% off for 10 days ♥
notes.notes:
Hello there dear Wanderers! We're so happy to get back to you!

We hope you had a wonderful summer, with lots of games and sweet wandering ♥
We have something for you to kick off this back to work time with the right foot: a discount!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950399/fb79e77edef723babf8d05e0a30c8e8dc0bb0b59.png

And also, as you may have seen if you already own the game, a little patch notes to fix a few more things :D
Here is what we've done:

• Game is lighter! It's now 6.5GB!
• The performance issues in the snowy lands has been fixed
• Some UI textures sometimes went all blur, not anymore!
• Dashing foes can no longer keep the player aggro after you died
• The graphical options menu now always shows the right resolution ;)

So, if you haven't tried Shattered already, this is kind of the best time ever! The game is in its final version along with a big discount, soooo we can't wait to have your feedback!


And so, now that we're here, what is next for Redlock Studio?

Well... We can't tell you exactly what's going on, really.
But we're onto stuff.
Cool stuff.

We're sorry we have to keep the mysterious act for now, but we can't wait to tell you more (soon!) ♥

In the meantime, don't hesitate to join our Discord if you want to ask anything or chat directly with some of us.

Click here to join our Discord server!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950399/a30787e2c8d683b79b7b7d5d95d2c3d3d1d3db80.png

notes.title: THE FULL RELEASE IS HERE!
notes.notes:
Yes Wanderers, you read it right...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950399/96be4eb77c126c7f5fcd4ef2aa69a75eb885e6e5.png

After 5 years of hard work, a Kickstart campaign, lots of ups and downs and a year of early access, the official 1.0 version of the game is finally ready.

We couldn't have done it without all of your feedback, so we wanted to thank you once again.

You made the game what it is today, and you definitely made us better devs, artists, writers and designers. From the bottom of our 5 little hearts: THANK YOU ♥

Please note that due to a little delay in our comms with Valve, the launch sale will be a bit late: so tune in in 20 minutes from now for a 15% off launch discount!

About the languages: the game is currently in French and English only.
A post launch update will come as soon as we can with Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish and German.
Other languages are still in discussion (we have duly noted the interested of Turkish players) we'll let you know how it goes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950399/a30787e2c8d683b79b7b7d5d95d2c3d3d1d3db80.png

notes.title: Last patch notes until full release
notes.notes:
Hello there, dear Wanderers!

As you know, we’re now less than a month away from Shattered’s full release. But we didn’t want to let you hanging until then with a 3 months old version of the game, so… This update is a big one.
Such a big one, that we won’t tell you precisely what we fixed and added, because there is SO much. We’ll just let you discover the reworked areas, new NPCs, etc. etc... ♥

What we’re going to do though, is telling you what is still missing and the bugs we already know and are still working on.
Let’s have a look:

• You now have access to everything in the game, EXCEPT for the last zone. That means the full release will still have surprises for you : the said last zone, endings, last Boss… 
• The Quick Access Inventory will be improved & fixed
• We’ll add and/or balance certain craft recipes
• There’s a bit of polishing left on combat gameplay and a few enemies/Bosses
• We’ll do some level art polishing (collision issues etc), and some UI/FX/visual rendering improvement.
• For more fun, we let a few occasional crashes the possibility to happen. (No, we’re sorry about that and are investigating the matter as you’re reading this)

Due to the amount of changes we made, you really have to start a new game, otherwise your save will probably end up completely corrupted.

This will also be the last update until the full release.

We hope you’ll enjoy, and as always, don’t hesitate to let us know what you think, here or on social media ♥

• Twitter
• Instagram
• Facebook
• Discord

Really changed.
We'll make an update in the upcoming days for you to see it all that has happened!

We'll keep coming with more content and news until then.

Also, we'll post more often on our social media, so join us if you don't want to miss anything :)

notes.title: Build 0.12 Hotfix!
notes.notes:
Hey again dear Wanderers,

Thank you so much for your quick feedback and positive comments on the last update, we're so glad you liked it ♥
We've been able to make a little hotfix, since a few problematic bugs had shown up.

Here it is:

    • Fix of the crashes that happened when fighting the Stranger and Gheb
    • Fix of display bugs in the binding menu
    • Fix of the freeze that happened when you used a Mark from the inventory
    • The casting bar of the Marks no longer stays on the screen afterwards
    • Loot still appears even if you hide the HUD
    • Fix of the link between Limbo and the door of Khotar
    • Legionaries now have a thrust attack with a wider dash, and gained a few adjustments on their AI
    • Damage reduction for the charged attacks, light and heavy 
    • The door of Khotar can't be skipped anymore
    • We also made a few display corrections on certain maps.


As always, we're all ears for your feedback!
If you'd like to report something, ask a question or chat with us, don't hesitate to join our official Discord server ♥ https://discord.gg/cGmC9Bt

See you soon, Wanderers!

notes.title: Back to school sale & what to expect from the next update
notes.notes:
Hello there dear Wanderers!
We hope you had a great summer and were able to take a break. We took a little one ourselves, and got back to bettering Shattered!

To try and make that "back to school" time a bit less annoying, we decided to put 20% off Shattered for the next 14 days while we finish up the next patch notes. As always, if you already own the game and would like to support us, please tell your friends about the discount and/or put a positive review here on Steam, that's an awesome and super efficient way to help ♥

Oh and, since you're here, wanna know what the upcoming patch notes will be about?
Well, friends, here you go:
• The next update will contain a brand new Demiurge to fight. We don't want to say too much about it, but it might be the very first one we ever worked on, that we've been reworking and reworking and reworking for the past few years... We cannot wait to know what you'll think of it!
• The craft system will finally be here...
• ... As well as the weapon upgrade system!
• New distribution of the foes.
• And probably a new Pretorian :)

If you'd like to follow the development of the game, we're putting regular content on our social media: 
Twitter: RedlockStudio
Facebook: Taleoftheforgottenking
Instagram: redlockstudio
...and join our lovely Discord community to chat with us!

Until next time dear Wanderers, be safe! ♥

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.notes:
We just fixed the Limbo wells!
No more respawning problems and neverending mists.

You should probably restart your game, to make sure everything is ok now ♥

notes.title: BIG UPDATE! The first Demiurge and the Summer sales! ♥
notes.notes:
Wanderers, we have big news!
This patch notes contains the very first Demiurge of Hypnos, to go with these Summer sales!
We cannot wait for you to try it, and we hope you'll enjoy that harsh fight! There's also an entirely new area for you to roam... Please let us know what you think ♥

More details about all of this:

BUGFIXES:

Lots of crashes have been fixed
When sprinting then falling, stamina stops decreasing
Debug of the spawn and death of the Dark Wander
Debug of the Homonculuses' colliders


ADDITIONS: 

 NEW AREA, NEW BOSS!
 New moving grass for the Ancient Lands
 Spell system! With 3 spells for the moment: invisibility, shield and a weapon buff
 We added a little freeze frame when the Wanderer touches a foe. Let us know what you think about it !
 A little light under the Wanderer for better, easier jumps during platforming phases
 New music in the Ancient Lands, new theme for Ackbar!


CHANGES:

 With no lock on, Ether bolts are now cast toward the middle of your screen     
 You can now sprint while the camera is locked on a enemy (the locked sprint is slower than the regular one)

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.notes:
Hey Wanderers :)
We made a quick fix for this 11th build!
Let us know if you find anything else, but that should finish fixing everything we've heard of ♥

Bugfixes: 
- Stamina now charges back normally when backstabbing right after an attack
- If you try to parry when your stamina is too low, the parry will still work
- Fixed the bug that shrinked the jump (that was really fun though)
- Once open, the puzzle door will stay open! Yay!

Optimization:
- Ancient lands have been optimized to improve framerates
- Hod's arena has been optimized to also improve framerates
- Light optimization of load times


Changes : 
- Backstabs and counter attacks now take stamina. Careful!
- You cannot parry with the ether bolt anymore. Careful :D
- Added new sounds in the level up UI!

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We noticed a few bugs had come up with the last update, so we made a quick fix before the next major patch notes :)

BUGFIX:

 Foes won't aggro on respawn anymore.
 Stamina doesn't recharge during the heavy attacks animations anymore.
 Players won't be able to move in the Quick Access section through the consumables options in the inventory.
 Players won't be able to “negatively use” a consumable (that happened when spamming the using button during UI animations).
 Items won't stack instead of being deleted during updates of the inventory.
 Wrong textures were displayed when hoevering buttons from the consumable options.
 No more glitches on QA clicking!
 No more getting stuck after respawning at the second well in the Limbo.
 You won't lose your looted keys anymore. We had the inventory swear it: it will save all of them.


MODIFICATIONS / ADDITIONS:

 Aerial attack nerf: it deals less damage, takes more stamina and has a much more important landing lag. Yes, it was needed. You know it.
 Striking a Legionary will only stun them once, then they'll finish their current attack no matter what.
 Click anywhere else to exit the Quick Access selection in the main UI.
 Click on the background to exit the consumable options.
